author: Zetu Zetu Form
text: Big moves in Langas today! Our Street to Studio crew laid down three new conscious tracks. The energy was unreal — raw talent meeting real purpose. This is what the New Breed looks like.

author: Zetu Zetu Form
text: Saturday cleanup drive was massive. Over 40 young people showed up to clear drainage lines and reclaim the dump zone near Stage 12. Sanitation is self-respect. Form ni zetu!

author: Zetu Zetu Form
text: Neighborhood tournament finals brought together three estates that rarely see eye to eye. Football bridged the divide. Peace won the real trophy. #UnityOverConflict

author: Zetu Zetu Form
text: Peer counseling circle hit a milestone — 150 sessions completed. Real conversations about substance abuse, pressure, and finding purpose. No judgment, just support. The Safehouse doors stay open.

author: Zetu Zetu Form
text: Leadership Academy Saturday seminar tackled financial literacy basics. 30 young leaders learned budgeting, saving, and how to think like owners of their future. Knowledge is the real power.

author: Zetu Zetu Form
text: Graffiti art workshop turned the alley behind our center into a canvas. Young artists reclaimed the space with color and message. The walls now speak hope instead of neglect.
